# Saurabh Dohaiya

> Backend-focused software engineer, formerly at Aspora, available to join immediately.

Saurabh was a Software Engineer at Aspora (YC W22, previously Vance) from December 2024 to August 2026. He is seeking backend roles and can join immediately. His work includes backend services, platform engineering, distributed configuration, server-driven UI, and full-stack products.
